verdict.rationale: Nitrokey ships an official nitropy CLI that installs non-interactively from PyPI and runs headlessly (verified via uvx). The NetHSM offers a REST API with an OpenAPI spec and a Docker test image intended for testing and development, which together make scripted, headless automation plausible. However, nothing documents CI usage explicitly, and the USB keys rely on local protocols with touch confirmation on Nitrokey 3, which limits unattended operation. Missing for 10: explicit CI/headless automation documentation, non-interactive operation guidance for the USB keys, and hands-on CI pipeline corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation
